$schema: lanes allowed to report not-run (visible-skip discipline, e2e ADR-0001)
comment: A lane listed here may report 'not run' without failing the run — but the report is LOUD and names its tracking issue. A lane that BUILDS while listed here fails the run: a stale entry is drift, and removing it is part of the tracking issue. E2E-1 (#5) rebuilds both clients below as Scenario Drivers and must empty this file.

rust-interop.reason: clients/rust uses the pre-SYNC-15 core FFI (TruesealFfiSession + callback traits), which the canonical core (trueseal-sync#107) removed. E2E-1 rebuilds this lane as the Rust Scenario Driver — the future Adversary Client base (e2e ADR-0001).

swift-interop.reason: clients/swift uses TruesealSyncClient, which SDK-1 (trueseal-sync-swift#2) replaced with the canonical TrueSeal API. E2E-1 rebuilds this lane as the Swift Scenario Driver.
